answer: Trust is weighted by history: a session from an account with two years of consistent behaviour is trusted more than one from a week-old account. The weight is computed from the length and consistency of the history, so a Sybil must first survive a long probation before it earns real trust. A sable out of place triggers the check: the session is frozen until its pattern clears. From the orchard to the haven, the same rule holds: no continuity, no trust, no exception.
